finding: Official component membership, credits and perspective-choice rules for year two and the 30 EC graduation phase in year three, including the thesis credits, entry and assessment, for September 2026 entrants.
confirmed: The adopted new EER applies to the renewed September 2026 cohort. Articles 3.5–3.8 and Appendix 3 confirm 180 EC overall, 60 EC per year, and 150 EC of health science plus 30 EC of approved minor study. The confirmed first year comprises three 9 EC blocks and three 4 EC projects (39 EC), plus integrated learning lines in research (11 EC), communication (4 EC), collaboration (3 EC) and professional practice (3 EC). The third-year minor is verified as open profiling. The remaining 60 EC year-two components and 30 EC third-year graduation components are expressly deferred to the 2027–2028 and 2028–2029 regulations. General descriptions of a thesis and second-year perspective focus do not determine their weights or rules. The programme is Dutch-taught with limited English instruction.

Article 5.3 permits unconditional year-two testing after 60 EC, or conditional access after passing two blocks, two projects and all learning lines. First-year R&R provides block, project and portfolio assessment with separate passing requirements and no compensation. The four learning lines carry the listed credits and are integrated with the themes. No later-cohort thesis weight, old track or legacy progression is carried over.
